'''Docking Bay 31''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] [[Angor Farn]] stationed his ship here while trying to sell stolen [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] parts to [[Armanda Durkin]].<ref name="GG7" />
